legacy_storyboard_compatibility.reason: The frozen storyboard uses legacy element ids and cannot be converted by build_timed_storyboard_v2 without explicit v2 element_id values.
legacy_storyboard_compatibility.allowed_output: legacy timed storyboard with measured semantic sentence cues

provenance.reason: R4 generated all 35 SAPI sentence files and 10 merged WAV files, then was preserved after the T2V_RESEARCH_GENERATION_V2 flag attempted to convert a legacy storyboard whose elements do not carry v2 element_id values. V5 freezes the validated legacy-storyboard execution mode and leaves all V4 subtitle, source-image and pairing controls unchanged.
provenance.platform_requirement: Windows with an enabled zh-CN System.Speech voice

storage_policy: Generated audio, sentence cues, subtitles and runtime hash manifests stay in the ignored run bundle; audio and video binaries are not committed to Git.
